review_method: Read every complete actual source unit across 1 Kings 19–22 and all proposed targets and necessary context through complete_text, then generated 143 particular retained connections. Separately read every full source/target/category/rationale triple in bounded displays, with no clipped output. Preserved the original author draft; a coherent three-triple refinement retained the Chronicles from-a-chamber wording, replaced an unreported exchanged-clothing category with a clothing-directive category, and removed an added commanders-hearing clause. Each of the three corrected full triples was separately displayed and reread. Local literary relationships are explicitly labelled, and external relationships use particular quotations, repeated formulas, law contrasts, service continuity, or parallel narrated actions. This is an initial curated English reading, not exhaustive discovery, original-language certification, apparatus review, or independent human specialist approval.
pin_method: Freshly fetched raw GitHub verses.json for every used book at the fixed commit; rehashed the exact Git blob and compared against immutable source registries, then compared each complete parsed raw JSON with the complete parsed cache. Saved each raw blob and SHA256. Cache newline differences are recorded and do not alter parsed content. Inventory and technical verification give no completed-reading credit.

before.rationale: The prophet answers that his challenger will see when he enters an inner chamber to hide; Chronicles records the corresponding prediction of a chamber within a chamber. The shared hiding prediction is retained without supplying a later fulfillment absent from these targets.

after.rationale: The prophet answers that his challenger will see when he enters an inner chamber to hide; Chronicles records the corresponding prediction using a chamber from a chamber. The shared hiding prediction is retained without supplying a later fulfillment absent from these targets.

unresolved_candidates.status: pending proposed accession-synchronism harmonization; no chronology reconciliation credit
unresolved_candidates.reason: The complete source dates Jehoshaphat son of Asa becoming king to Ahab fourth year, whereas the earlier continuation places that named accession in Omri eleventh year. The retained bounded connection is the named accession notice only. No chronological equation or independent coregency solution is established.

candidate_exclusions.proposed_claim: Resolve Jehu son-of-Nimshi versus fuller parentage as a genealogical equation; independently identify spelling variants of persons or places; harmonize Naboth/Ahab blood locations; compute or reconcile battle numbers, about four hundred versus four hundred, reign dates, or maternal names; identify the unnamed heavenly spirit; supply direct Elijah anointings not narrated in the targets; read missing royal annals; import random shooting, an armor proverb, a self-judgment answer, or familiar edition numbering.
candidate_exclusions.reason: These unestablished claims receive no completed identity, numerical, geographical, textual, or chronology reconciliation credit. Only the particular supported partial relationships described in retained rationales are credited.
